title: COMP 3522 C++ · Week 5
subtitle: Exceptions and assertions, noexcept and the standard exceptions; coupling and cohesion, the five SOLID principles and the Law of Demeter, preparing for Quiz 5 and the midterm
description: Everything in the Week 5 deck and the Week5 sample programs: assertions versus exceptions, throw and try-catch, the six catch guidelines (by reference, first match, child before parent, the ellipsis last, terminate or rethrow), noexcept and why destructors never throw, std::exception and what(), the logic_error and runtime_error families, terminate; then design: coupling and cohesion, dependencies and decoupling with abstractions, Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion, and the Law of Demeter. Every program runnable with its real output, the design examples redrawn as UML you can click, and the practice-midterm Fraction constructor worked. A mock quiz and a cheat sheet close the week.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 5 scope and the midterm
Same format as before (multiple choice, true/false, matching, what-does-this-print) at the start of lab, covering the **Week 5 slides** and the **Week5 sample programs** (exception.cpp to exception5.cpp). The midterm on **Wednesday Oct 29, 3:30 pm, SW03-1710** (90 minutes, one double-sided cheat sheet) covers Weeks 1 to 7; the practice midterm asks you to write a Fraction constructor that throws, which is this week's material.
:::

steps.note: take it cold first, so you know where the gaps are (about 40 min)
by reference, first match, child before parent, ellipsis last; play the matcher until every case is obvious
what() is virtual; logic_error vs runtime_error; what terminate does; exception5.cpp line by line
throw anything, but define a type; read_matrix_file with an error code and with an exception
one reason to change; open for extension, closed for modification; the UIWidget if-chain
vector<UIWidget*>; no client forced to depend on functions it does not use
both sides depend on the abstraction; count the dots in a train wreck
write the throwing Fraction constructor on paper, then the character-creation redesign
print it and read it on the way in
